groups.defect: `max_processes or len(buffer.assigned_shards)` treats 0 as missing, and with empty assigned_shards it gives num_processes=0, so no flusher processes or buffers are created.
groups.rationale: All three flag the same `or` truthiness expression on line 51 and propose the same fix: an explicit None check, optionally clamped to at least 1. They stress different consequences (an explicit 0 vs. empty shards), so the merged comment should cover both.

groups.defect: test_basic monkeypatches time.sleep to a no-op, so the added time.sleep(0.1) wait for the flusher does nothing and the test stays racy.
groups.rationale: Both report the same no-op sleep in the same test caused by the earlier monkeypatch.

groups.defect: When the deadline expires, the `break` in join() exits early, so the remaining processes are never waited on or terminated.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same early-break leak in the multi-process join loop and suggest the same fix.
